correctness.rationale: Over arbitrary characteristic-two field, in H=span(e0,e1), W=span(e0+e2,e1+e3), the multiplication xy=ε(y)x+α(x)β(y)u+β(x)α(y)v makes W the intrinsic right annihilator. Automorphisms preserve W and ε, so block matrices have A on H, B on W and arbitrary shear C:H→W. Multiplicativity cancels C and forces Bm(h,k)=m(Ah,Ak). From m(h0,h0)=m(h1,h1)=0 one gets ac=bd=0 for invertible A; preservation of ε restricts A to I or the swap P, and B is respectively I or P. Hence all C∈M2(K) and the simultaneous swap yield (M2(K),+)⋊C2, order 2q^4 over Fq. A completely independent brute-force check enumerated all 20160 GL4(F2) matrices against all 16 multiplication-table products and found precisely 32 automorphisms, matching the all-field structural proof.
